offering_description.value: Produces and sells frozen potato products such as french fries, tots, hash browns and other potato and appetizer items. Customers are restaurants, quick-service chains, foodservice distributors and grocery retailers. Products are made in company-owned processing plants from contracted potato supplies.

primary_products.value: frozen french fries; frozen potato specialties (tots, hash browns); frozen appetizers and vegetable items; private-label frozen potato products

customer_segment.value: B2B: quick-service restaurant chains, full-service restaurants, foodservice distributors, theaters, convenience stores, retail grocery chains

end_markets.value: restaurants and quick-service foodservice; grocery retail; food distribution; convenience and entertainment venues

revenue_model.value: product sales: frozen potato products sold to restaurant chains, distributors and retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes contracted raw potatoes into frozen products, sold to restaurants, distributors and retailers; brand owner: owns branded and licensed retail and foodservice potato product lines

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East, plants in the US, Canada, Europe and China

specialization.value: niche specialist: frozen potato products with some related appetizer and vegetable lines

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: large restaurant chains and national accounts; distributors / dealers: broadline foodservice distributors; third-party retail: grocery retailers carrying branded and private-label products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety rules (FDA, USDA, FSMA), environmental and wastewater regulation, and international trade and tariff rules
